Callout.Name: Unlicensed Cab
Callout.Message: Unlicensed driver picking up at a taxi rank.
Callout.Advisory: One vehicle, driver arguing with licensed drivers.

Script.Line: I am giving a mate a lift. That is not a taxi.
No money has changed hands. Ask him.
The plate on the roof is for show. It is a joke.

Lines.Approach: He is taking fares off the rank and the licensed drivers have told him twice. It is getting loud.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
